answer: Best mechanism: on-ledger slashing of verifiers who countersign invalid transactions, priced above any epoch reward. Each verifier posts a bond; when a fraud-proof proves a transaction invalid, every countersigner is slashed on-chain, losing more than an epoch could pay. A sybil attacker funds a bond per fake identity, and one fraud event seizes them all, so scaling fakes multiplies capital at risk, not profit. Forgery is a net loss. Honest verification spreads like juniper, attacks wither like cut yarrow, bad blocks turn to nebula dust.
